comments.onnxruntime-node: Pinned exactly, and overridden for the whole tree. Supertonic loads onnxruntime-node directly while Kokoro loads it via @huggingface/transformers, which depends on exactly 1.21.0. Two copies in one process means two native bindings, and the second engine to load dies with 'The requested API version [29] is not available'. Keep these in lockstep.
